canon_vs_inference.note_en: The letter is dated 3-10 June 1959, which does not match the publication year 1961; the novel says so, and the discrepancy is left as it stands.
canon_vs_inference.topic: 故事内年份1959年与出版年1961年不一致
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: The in-story year 1959 versus the publication year 1961

canon_vs_inference.note_en: M guesses from a suspected DEW radar trace that the aircraft flew south to the Bahamas; the novel states this plainly as a guess and a gamble, not as confirmed intelligence.
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: M's guess that the aircraft is hidden in the Bahamas

canon_vs_inference.note: 邦德与莱特推测利普曾为寄信人、SPECTRE为灭口杀利普，原文中莱特以假设语气提出，邦德未证实
canon_vs_inference.note_en: Bond and Leiter guess that Lippe posted the letter and that SPECTRE killed him to silence him; in the novel Leiter puts this forward as a hypothesis, and Bond does not confirm it.
canon_vs_inference.topic: 利普是寄信人且被SPECTRE灭口
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: Lippe as the letter-writer, killed by SPECTRE to silence him

canon_vs_inference.note: 原文未写布洛菲尔德全名之外的SPECTRE总部确切地址以外的细节，仅写巴黎奥斯曼大道136号之二FIRCO办公室
canon_vs_inference.note_en: The novel gives no detail of SPECTRE headquarters beyond the FIRCO office at 136 bis Boulevard Haussmann, Paris.

canon_vs_inference.note: 原文未说明第二枚核弹在水下决战后如何处置，仅写两枚核弹均已回收
canon_vs_inference.note_en: The novel does not say how the second atomic bomb is disposed of after the underwater battle, only that both bombs have been recovered.
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: The fate of the second atomic bomb

canon_vs_inference.note_en: In Chapter 16 Bond finds a roughly twelve-foot-square underwater hatch in the Disco Volante's hull, and the Geiger counter reads normal, with no radiation detected.
canon_vs_inference.topic: 飞碟号水下舱门与盖革计数器读数
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: The Disco Volante's underwater hatch and the Geiger counter reading

chapters.summary: 邦德因体检报告极差被M强制送往灌木林自然疗养院疗养两周，M本人迷上自然疗法，钱彭妮透露M去疗养后大为改观。
chapters.summary_en: Bond's medical report is appalling, and M orders him to spend two weeks at the Shrublands nature-cure clinic; M himself has taken to nature cure, and Miss Moneypenny tells Bond how much it changed him.
chapters.title: Take It Easy, Mr. Bond

chapters.summary: 邦德乘出租车抵达苏塞克斯郡华盛顿附近的灌木林疗养院，见院长韦恩并接受检查，救下险被利普伯爵的宾利撞到的帕特里夏·费林，洗澡时发现利普腕表下藏有红闪电帮会纹身。
chapters.summary_en: Bond takes a taxi to the Shrublands clinic near Washington, Sussex, meets its director Wain and is examined; he saves Patricia Fearing from being run down by Count Lippe's Bentley, and while bathing notices a Red Lightning Tong tattoo hidden under Lippe's watch.
chapters.title: Shrublands

chapters.summary: 邦德向总部档案处查询纹身，得知为澳门红闪电帮会标志；接受牵引床治疗时利普悄悄将牵引力调至200磅企图谋杀邦德，费林及时发现救下邦德。
chapters.summary_en: Bond asks Headquarters records about the tattoo and learns it is the mark of the Macao Red Lightning Tong; while he is on the traction machine, Lippe secretly cranks the pull up to 200 lb in an attempt to murder him, and Fearing saves him in time.
chapters.title: The Rack

chapters.summary: 邦德谎称事故是自己误触拉杆，接受费林护理后康复；暗中监视利普，搜查其房间无果；最后一天将利普困在土耳其浴室并把温度调至180度报复，利普出价5万英镑求饶。
chapters.summary_en: Bond pretends the accident was his own fault in touching the lever, recovers under Fearing's care, and keeps Lippe under observation, searching his room without result; on his last day he locks Lippe in the Turkish bath and turns the heat up to 180 degrees in revenge, and Lippe offers £50,000 to be let out.
chapters.title: Tea and Animosity

chapters.summary: SPECTRE在巴黎奥斯曼大道136号之二以FIRCO慈善组织为掩护开会，介绍首领布洛菲尔德的生平与SPECTRE的构成：20名成员分属西西里黑手党、科西嘉联合会、前苏联肃反组织、前盖世太保、南斯拉夫秘密警察与土耳其海洛因集团，另有两名科学家。
chapters.summary_en: SPECTRE meets in Paris at 136 bis Boulevard Haussmann under the cover of the FIRCO charity, introducing its leader Blofeld and the organisation's make-up: twenty members drawn from the Sicilian Mafia, the Union Corse, the former Soviet SMERSH, the former Gestapo, the Yugoslav secret police and a Turkish heroin ring, plus two scientists.
chapters.title: S.P.E.C.T.R.E.

chapters.summary: 布洛菲尔德在会上处决强奸人质的12号博罗，交代欧米茄计划因利普误事延期一周，确认拉戈为现场最高指挥，商定金条在埃特纳火山空投与经卡塔尼亚、苏伊士运河至果阿的转运方案。
chapters.summary_en: At the meeting Blofeld executes No. 12, Borraud, for raping a hostage; he explains that Operation Omega has been put back a week because of Lippe's blunder, confirms Largo as supreme commander in the field, and settles the plan for the gold to be parachuted onto Mount Etna and then shipped on via Catania, the Suez Canal and Goa.
chapters.title: Violet-Scented Breath

chapters.summary: 邦德疗养归来状态大好，忽接M紧急召唤；M出示SPECTRE寄给首相的勒索信：英军轰炸机携两枚核弹失踪，赎金为价值1亿英镑的金条，限期7天，逾期先炸价值相当的财产，48小时后再炸一座大城市。
chapters.summary_en: Bond returns from the cure in excellent shape, only to be urgently summoned by M; M shows him SPECTRE's blackmail letter to the Prime Minister: a British bomber carrying two atomic bombs has vanished, the ransom is £100 million in gold, with seven days to pay, after which SPECTRE will first destroy property of equal value and then a major city 48 hours later.
chapters.title: «Fasten Your Lap-Strap»

chapters.summary: M介绍案情：轰炸机为博斯科姆唐第5试验中队的维利尔斯复仇者号，机组5人加意大利观察员佩塔基，飞机在爱尔兰以西失踪，DEW雷达曾见一架飞机南飞；M凭直觉派邦德去巴哈马调查；利普在伦敦街头企图枪杀邦德，被SPECTRE的6号骑摩托车以手榴弹炸死。
chapters.summary_en: M briefs Bond: the missing aircraft is the Villiers Vindicator of No. 5 Experimental Squadron at Boscombe Down, with a crew of five plus the Italian observer Petacchi; it vanished west of Ireland, and DEW radar once tracked an aircraft flying south; M sends Bond to the Bahamas on instinct; in a London street Lippe tries to shoot Bond and is blown up by SPECTRE's No. 6, who kills him with a grenade from a motorcycle.
chapters.title: «Big Fleas Have Little Fleas . . .»

chapters.summary: 倒叙劫机经过：佩塔基受SPECTRE收买，以氰化物毒气杀死5名机组人员，独自驾机飞越大西洋，在比米尼附近海面迫降，登机后被瓦尔加斯以短剑刺死，SPECTRE潜水员取出两枚核弹并以伪装篷布覆盖飞机残骸。
chapters.summary_en: Flashback to the hijack: Petacchi, bought by SPECTRE, kills the five-man crew with cyanide gas, flies the bomber alone across the Atlantic, ditches it in the sea off Bimini, and is stabbed to death with a stiletto by Vargas as he climbs out; SPECTRE divers remove the two atomic bombs and cover the wreck with a camouflage tarpaulin.
chapters.title: Multiple Requiem

chapters.summary: 拉戈在飞碟号上指挥回收核弹，物理学家科策为核弹改装定时引信；飞碟号为水翼快艇，载两枚核弹后驶往狗岛，将核弹藏于岛下岩洞。
chapters.summary_en: Aboard the Disco Volante, Largo supervises the recovery of the bombs while the physicist Kotze fits them with time fuses; the Disco is a hydrofoil yacht, and after taking the two bombs aboard she sails for Dog Island, where the bombs are hidden in a cave under the island.
chapters.title: The Disco Volante

chapters.summary: 邦德在拿骚街头结识拉戈的情人多米诺·维塔利，得知其29岁、生于博尔扎诺、父母死于火车事故、曾就读切尔滕纳姆女子学院与皇家戏剧艺术学院；两人共进午餐并相约赌场见面。
chapters.summary_en: On the streets of Nassau Bond meets Domino Vitali, Largo's mistress, and learns she is 29, born in Bolzano, her parents killed in a train accident, and educated at Cheltenham Ladies' College and the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art; they lunch together and agree to meet at the casino.
chapters.title: Domino

chapters.summary: 邦德到机场接应化名拉金的莱特，两人确认合作；莱特推测利普即寄信人且被SPECTRE灭口；莱特带来盖革计数器等装备，两人商议调查飞碟号。
chapters.summary_en: Bond meets Felix Leiter at the airport under the cover name Larkin, and the two confirm they will work together; Leiter guesses that Lippe was the letter-writer and that SPECTRE killed him to silence him; Leiter brings Geiger counters and other equipment, and they discuss how to investigate the Disco Volante.
chapters.title: The Man from the C.I.A.

chapters.summary: 邦德与莱特以看房为借口登上飞碟号，拉戈带其参观全船，莱特以伪装成照相机的盖革计数器检测无异常；邦德发现拉戈关于燃油与压载的说法可疑，且19名股东一人未见。
chapters.summary_en: Posing as prospective house-buyers, Bond and Leiter board the Disco Volante; Largo shows them round the whole ship, and Leiter's Geiger counter, disguised as a camera, finds nothing; Bond notices Largo's claims about fuel and ballast do not add up, and that one of the nineteen shareholders is nowhere to be seen.
chapters.title: «My Name Is Emilio Largo»

chapters.summary: 邦德查实飞碟号仅载500加仑柴油，与拉戈所言不符；当晚与莱特在赌场饮酒，莱特透露美军已调动曼塔号核潜艇与彭萨科拉战斗轰炸机中队待命；邦德决定夜潜飞碟号。
chapters.summary_en: Bond establishes that the Disco carries only 500 gallons of diesel, contradicting Largo's account; that evening he drinks with Leiter at the casino, where Leiter reveals the Americans have the nuclear submarine Manta and a squadron of fighter-bombers from Pensacola standing by; Bond decides to dive on the Disco that night.
chapters.title: Sour Martinis

chapters.summary: 邦德在赌场与拉戈对赌chemin de fer三连胜，言语试探中拉戈听到spectre一词脸色骤变；邦德与多米诺共进夜宵，多米诺坦言与拉戈貌合神离，并透露本姓佩塔基，兄长朱塞佩为飞行员。
chapters.summary_en: At the casino Bond plays chemin de fer against Largo and wins three coups in a row; in the fencing of words Largo's face changes sharply at the word 'spectre'; Bond has supper with Domino, who admits her affair with Largo is a sham and reveals that her family name is Petacchi and her brother Giuseppe is a pilot.
chapters.title: Cardboard Hero

chapters.summary: 邦德在桑托斯协助下夜潜飞碟号，发现船底约12英尺见方水下舱门，盖革计数器无反应；遭SPECTRE水下哨兵以二氧化碳鱼枪袭击，哨兵被大梭鱼咬死，船上又投下手榴弹，邦德侥幸逃脱。
chapters.summary_en: With Constable Santos's help, Bond dives on the Disco at night and finds a roughly twelve-foot-square underwater hatch in her hull; the Geiger counter reads normal; he is attacked by a SPECTRE underwater sentry with a CO2 spear gun, the sentry is killed by a barracuda, and grenades are dropped from the ship above - Bond escapes by luck.
chapters.title: Swimming the Gantlet

chapters.summary: 莱特在赌场认出化名特劳特的股东实为东德物理学家科策；两人乘水上飞机搜索，在比米尼以南海域发现鲨鱼聚集处，邦德潜入伪装篷布下的失事飞机，取回佩塔基的身份牌与金表，确认核弹与引信均已被取走。
chapters.summary_en: At the casino Leiter recognises the shareholder calling himself Traut as the East German physicist Kotze; the two fly out in a seaplane to search, find sharks gathering in the sea south of Bimini, and Bond dives under the camouflage tarpaulin into the wrecked bomber, recovering Petacchi's identity disc and gold watch and confirming that the bombs and their fuses have already been removed.
chapters.title: The Red-Eye Catacomb

chapters.summary: 邦德与多米诺在海滩幽会并发生关系，随后向她坦白兄长死讯与全部案情；多米诺同意携带盖革计数器登船做内应，以是否上甲板为信号。
chapters.summary_en: Bond and Domino meet on the beach and become lovers; he then tells her of her brother's death and the whole case; Domino agrees to go aboard the Disco as his inside agent, carrying a Geiger counter, with her appearance on deck as the signal.
chapters.title: How to Eat a Girl

chapters.summary: 多米诺得知兄长死讯后同意做内应，条件是拉戈必须被杀或判终身监禁；她登船前将兄长的金表链抛入大海；莱特视察帕尔米拉无果，曼塔号抵达拿骚。
chapters.summary_en: Learning of her brother's death, Domino agrees to act as Bond's agent aboard, on condition that Largo be killed or imprisoned for life; before boarding she throws her brother's gold watch-chain into the sea; Leiter's inspection of Palmyra finds nothing, and the Manta arrives at Nassau.
chapters.title: When the Kissing Stopped

chapters.summary: 邦德与莱特登上曼塔号见佩德森舰长，商定跟踪飞碟号；警方通报水上飞机已于17时30分返回，飞碟号17时55分全速向西北出航，多米诺登船后未再上甲板露面。
chapters.summary_en: Bond and Leiter board the Manta and meet her captain, Commander Pedersen, agreeing to shadow the Disco; the police report that the seaplane returned at 17:30 and the Disco sailed at full speed to the north-west at 17:55, with Domino aboard and never seen on deck again.
chapters.title: Time for Decision

chapters.summary: 拉戈发现多米诺携带伪装盖革计数器，将其绑在铺位上以雪茄与冰块折磨逼供；会上俄罗斯人斯特雷利克提议留人监督被拉戈开枪打死；拉戈部署午夜3时在大巴哈马岛外布放第一枚核弹。
chapters.summary_en: Largo discovers the Geiger counter Domino is carrying, has her tied to her bunk and tortures her with a cigar and ice to make her talk; at the meeting the Russian Strelik proposes leaving men behind to supervise and is shot dead by Largo; Largo orders the first bomb to be laid off Grand Bahama at 3 a.m.
chapters.title: Very Softly, Very Slowly

chapters.summary: 曼塔号在雷达上发现飞碟号全速北上，佩德森舰长说明浅滩水域潜艇无法跟踪；邦德与莱特率9名潜水员组成水下战斗队，佩带编号潜水服与长矛，准备拦截布放核弹的SPECTRE潜水队。
chapters.summary_en: The Manta's radar picks up the Disco racing north at full speed; Captain Pedersen explains the submarine cannot follow in the shallow water; Bond and Leiter lead nine divers in an underwater combat team, wearing numbered diving suits and armed with spears, ready to intercept SPECTRE's bomb-laying divers.
chapters.title: The Shadower

chapters.summary: 水下决战：邦德率12人拦截拉戈的潜水队，双方在珊瑚礁中以鱼枪与长矛搏斗；拉戈企图拖走核弹雪橇，邦德在水面摩托艇上与其搏斗落败，多米诺挣脱束缚潜出船舱，以鱼枪刺穿拉戈脖颈救下邦德。
chapters.summary_en: The underwater battle: Bond leads twelve men against Largo's diving team, fighting with spear guns and lances among the coral; Largo tries to tow the bomb sled away, and Bond fights him on a motorised underwater chariot above the surface and loses; Domino breaks free of her bonds, swims out of the cabin and saves Bond by driving a spear gun through Largo's neck.
chapters.title: Naked Warfare

chapters.summary: 两枚核弹均已回收，科策被捕后供出SPECTRE内情，布洛菲尔德逃脱；第二枚核弹原定目标为迈阿密游艇港；多米诺全身多处烧伤但无生命危险，邦德在病房守在她床边睡去。
chapters.summary_en: Both atomic bombs are recovered; Kotze, captured, tells all he knows about SPECTRE, and Blofeld escapes; the second bomb was meant for the yacht harbour at Miami; Domino is badly burned in many places but out of danger, and Bond falls asleep beside her hospital bed.
chapters.title: «Take It Easy, Mr. Bond»

communications.name: 电话
communications.note: 邦德在灌木林以公用电话向总部档案处查询纹身；M与首相、总统以电话与信号联络
communications.note_en: Bond uses a public telephone at Shrublands to ask Headquarters records about the tattoo; M keeps in touch with the Prime Minister and the President by telephone and signal.

communications.name: 电报与电传打字机
communications.note: M办公室以Triple X密码向中情局、法方、北约与各站发报；邦德与莱特以密码机向伦敦与华盛顿发报
communications.note_en: M's office sends messages in Triple X code to the CIA, the French, NATO and the various stations; Bond and Leiter report to London and Washington on cipher machines.

communications.name: 无线电16兆周
communications.note: SPECTRE勒索信指定英美政府每小时整点在16兆周波段回复；SPECTRE内部亦用该波段联络
communications.note_en: The SPECTRE blackmail letter orders the British and American governments to reply on the hour on the 16-megacycle band; SPECTRE also uses this band for its own communications.

communications.name: 无线电20兆周
communications.note: 布洛菲尔德会后命18号以20兆周联络1号
communications.note_en: After the meeting Blofeld orders No. 18 to contact No. 1 on 20 megacycles.

communications.name: 对讲机
communications.note: 巴哈马警方监视人员以对讲机向总部报告飞碟号动向
communications.note_en: Bahamas police watchers report the Disco Volante's movements to headquarters by walkie-talkie.

communications.name: 舰船无线电
communications.note: 飞碟号radio room持续监听气象报告与拿骚方面通讯量
communications.note_en: The Disco Volante's radio room keeps a constant watch on weather reports and the volume of Nassau traffic.

equipment.note: 邦德配枪，第17章以其射杀锤头鲨
equipment.note_en: Bond's service pistol; in Chapter 17 he uses it to kill a hammerhead shark.

equipment.note: SPECTRE潜水队标配，射程约20英尺，矛头涂有箭毒
equipment.note_en: Standard issue for SPECTRE's divers, with a range of about twenty feet and a spearhead tipped with curare.

equipment.note: 莱特带来两台，一台伪装成禄莱照相机，一台水下型号；多米诺携带伪装型号登船
equipment.note_en: Leiter brings two: one disguised as a Rolleiflex camera and one underwater model; Domino takes the disguised model aboard.

equipment.note: 仿意大利二战载人鱼雷，由安萨尔多公司改进型
equipment.note_en: Modelled on the Italian Second World War manned torpedo, in an improved version by Ansaldo.

equipment.note: 用于水下运输重物，载运核弹
equipment.note_en: Used to carry heavy loads underwater, including the atomic bombs.

equipment.note: SPECTRE潜水员背负，螺旋桨推进，速度翻倍
equipment.note_en: Worn by SPECTRE divers; propeller-driven, doubling their speed.

equipment.note: 邦德携带Triple X密码机与莱特的中情局密码机
equipment.note_en: Bond carries a Triple X cipher machine, and Leiter a CIA cipher machine.

equipment.note: 拉戈发给水下布放小队提神增力
equipment.note_en: Dexedrine pills handed out by Largo to the bomb-laying swimming party to keep them alert and strong.

equipment.note: 曼塔号水下战斗队以缴获的弹簧刀改制，绑在扫帚柄上
equipment.note_en: Barbed spear lances made by the Manta's underwater combat team from captured flick-knives lashed to broom handles.

events.cause: 邦德体检报告极差，每天60支烟与半瓶烈酒，血压160/90
events.cause_en: Bond's medical report is appalling: sixty cigarettes a day and half a bottle of spirits, with blood pressure of 160/90.
events.effect: M强制邦德去灌木林疗养两周，邦德在疗养院撞见利普

events.cause: 邦德在电话亭向总部查询利普腕下纹身，被利普偷听

events.effect: 利普将牵引床调至200磅企图谋杀邦德未遂，邦德以土耳其浴室高温报复，利普二度烧伤入院
events.effect_en: Lippe turns the traction machine up to 200 lb in an attempt to murder Bond; the attempt fails, and Bond takes revenge by locking Lippe in the Turkish bath at high heat, leaving him with second-degree burns and in hospital.
events.title: 利普谋杀邦德未遂

events.cause: 利普因与邦德冲突烧伤住院，无法按期寄出勒索信
events.cause_en: Lippe is in hospital with burns after his clash with Bond and cannot post the blackmail letter on time.
events.effect: 欧米茄计划延期一周，佩塔基以流感病毒请病假等待
events.effect_en: Operation Omega is put back a week, and Petacchi calls in sick with flu to wait.
events.title: 欧米茄计划延期

events.cause: 佩塔基受SPECTRE以100万美元、新护照与里约机票收买
events.cause_en: Petacchi is bought by SPECTRE with $1,000,000, a new passport and a ticket to Rio de Janeiro.
events.effect: 佩塔基以氰化物毒死5名机组人员，驾机在比米尼附近迫降，随即被瓦尔加斯刺死，核弹被取走
events.effect_en: Petacchi kills the five-man crew with cyanide gas, ditches the bomber off Bimini, and is then stabbed to death by Vargas; the atomic bombs are removed.
events.title: 轰炸机被劫持

events.cause: SPECTRE寄给英国首相的勒索信要求1亿英镑金条，限期1959年6月10日17时
events.cause_en: SPECTRE's letter to the British Prime Minister demands £100 million in gold bars, with a deadline of 5 p.m. on 10 June 1959.
events.effect: 英美启动霹雳弹行动，全球搜寻飞机与核弹，M派邦德去巴哈马
events.effect_en: Britain and the United States launch Operation Thunderball, searching the world for the aircraft and the bombs, and M sends Bond to the Bahamas.
events.title: 核勒索信

events.cause: 利普出院后跟踪邦德企图枪杀报仇
events.cause_en: After leaving hospital, Lippe follows Bond and tries to shoot him in revenge.
events.effect: SPECTRE的6号骑摩托车以手榴弹炸死利普，邦德险些丧命
events.effect_en: SPECTRE's No. 6 kills Lippe with a grenade from a motorcycle, and Bond narrowly escapes death.
events.title: 利普被SPECTRE灭口

events.cause: 邦德怀疑飞碟号，莱特认出股东特劳特实为物理学家科策
events.cause_en: Bond suspects the Disco Volante, and Leiter recognises the shareholder Traut as the physicist Kotze.
events.effect: 邦德乘水上飞机搜索，在比米尼以南发现伪装篷布下的失事飞机，确认核弹已被取走
events.effect_en: Bond searches by seaplane and finds the wrecked bomber under a camouflage tarpaulin south of Bimini, confirming that the bombs have been removed.
events.title: 发现失事飞机残骸

events.cause: 多米诺得知兄长被拉戈下令杀害
events.cause_en: Domino learns that her brother was killed on Largo's orders.
events.effect: 多米诺同意携带盖革计数器登船做内应
events.effect_en: Domino agrees to go aboard carrying a Geiger counter as Bond's inside agent.
events.title: 多米诺转为邦德内应

events.cause: 多米诺携带的盖革计数器被发现
events.cause_en: The Geiger counter Domino is carrying is discovered.
events.effect: 拉戈以雪茄与冰块折磨逼供，多米诺一言不发；拉戈命人将其装入核弹铅壳灭口的计划未能实施
events.effect_en: Largo tortures her with a cigar and ice to make her talk; she says nothing, and Largo's plan to dispose of her in the lead casing of an atomic bomb is not carried out.
events.title: 多米诺遭折磨

events.cause: 飞碟号于17时55分出航北上，曼塔号雷达跟踪
events.cause_en: The Disco Volante sails north at full speed at 17:55, tracked by the Manta's radar.
events.effect: 邦德与莱特率9名潜水员出击，在大巴哈马岛外拦截布放核弹的潜水队
events.effect_en: Bond and Leiter take nine divers out to intercept the diving party laying the atomic bomb off Grand Bahama.
events.title: 曼塔号追踪飞碟号

events.cause: 拉戈率15人潜水队拖运核弹前往大巴哈马导弹基地布放
events.cause_en: Largo leads a fifteen-man diving party towing the atomic bomb to lay it off the Grand Bahama missile base.
events.effect: 水下混战，拉戈企图拖走核弹雪橇，多米诺挣脱束缚潜出，以鱼枪刺穿拉戈脖颈将其杀死，两枚核弹被回收
events.effect_en: In the underwater fighting Largo tries to tow the bomb sled away; Domino breaks free and swims out, killing Largo with a spear through the neck, and both atomic bombs are recovered.
events.title: 水下决战与拉戈之死
events.title_en: The underwater battle and Largo's death

facts.fact: 邦德体检报告称其每天抽60支巴尔干混合烟，饮酒约半瓶烈酒，血压160/90，医生建议休养2至3周
facts.fact_en: Bond's medical report states that he smokes sixty Balkan-mixture cigarettes a day, drinks about half a bottle of spirits, and has blood pressure of 160/90; his doctor advises two to three weeks' rest.
facts.quote: smoking sixty cigarettes a day

facts.fact: M因邦德体检报告差，强制其去苏塞克斯郡华盛顿附近的灌木林疗养院疗养两周
facts.fact_en: Because of Bond's poor medical report, M orders him to spend two weeks at the Shrublands nature-cure clinic near Washington, Sussex.
facts.quote: Place called Shrublands

facts.fact: 灌木林疗养院负责人为约书亚·韦恩，65岁，疗养费每周20畿尼
facts.fact_en: The Shrublands clinic is run by Joshua Wain, aged 65; the cure costs twenty guineas a week.
facts.quote: Run by quite a famous man in his line–Wain, Joshua Wain

facts.fact: 帕特里夏·费林在灌木林任职3年，为骨科治疗师
facts.fact_en: Patricia Fearing has worked at Shrublands for three years as the clinic's osteopath.
facts.quote: She had been at Shrublands for three years

facts.fact: 利普左腕内侧有红闪电帮会纹身，平时以腕表遮盖
facts.fact_en: Lippe has a Red Lightning Tong tattoo on the inside of his left wrist, normally hidden under his watch.
facts.quote: a sign tattooed on the skin

facts.fact: 红闪电帮会为纯犯罪组织，总部在澳门，在香港亦有活动，曾与英方香港站发生冲突
facts.fact_en: The Red Lightning Tong is a purely criminal organisation based in Macao and active in Hong Kong, which has clashed with the British station there.
facts.quote: The Red Lightning Tong. Unusual to find anyone but a full-blooded Chinaman

facts.fact: 利普将牵引床拉力调至200磅企图杀死邦德，邦德被费林救下
facts.fact_en: Lippe turns the traction machine up to a pull of 200 lb in an attempt to kill Bond; Bond is saved by Fearing.
facts.quote: the needle was trembling at 200

facts.fact: 邦德将土耳其浴室温度调至180度报复利普，利普出价5万英镑求饶未果
facts.fact_en: Bond turns the Turkish bath up to 180 degrees in revenge on Lippe; Lippe offers £50,000 to be released, without success.
facts.quote: Give you a thousand pounds and we're quits

facts.fact: 邦德疗养结束时血压降至132/84，体重减轻10磅
facts.fact_en: By the end of the cure Bond's blood pressure has fallen to 132/84 and he has lost ten pounds in weight.
facts.quote: blood pressure down to 132/84, weight reduced by ten pounds

facts.fact: 布洛菲尔德1908年5月28日生于格丁尼亚，父为波兰人，母为希腊人
facts.fact_en: Blofeld was born in Gdynia on 28 May 1908, the son of a Polish father and a Greek mother.
facts.quote: born in Gdynia of a Polish father and a Greek mother on May 28th, 1908

facts.fact: 布洛菲尔德曾在波兰邮电部任职，以代号TARTAR向德国出售情报，后又向美国与瑞典出售，获利20万美元
facts.fact_en: Blofeld worked in the Polish Ministry of Posts and Telegraphs, sold intelligence to the Germans under the codename TARTAR, and later sold to the Americans and the Swedes, making $200,000.
facts.quote: he christened his network TARTAR

facts.fact: 布洛菲尔德体重约280磅，不抽烟不喝酒，从未与任何性别的人发生过性关系
facts.fact_en: Blofeld weighs about 280 lb, neither smokes nor drinks, and has never had sexual relations with a member of either sex.
facts.quote: Blofeld's body weighed about two hundred and eighty pounds

facts.fact: SPECTRE全称为反情报、恐怖、报复与勒索特别执行部，总部以FIRCO慈善组织为掩护设于巴黎奥斯曼大道136号之二
facts.fact_en: SPECTRE stands for the Special Executive for Counterintelligence, Terrorism, Revenge, and Extortion; its headquarters, fronted by the FIRCO charity, is at 136 bis Boulevard Haussmann, Paris.
facts.quote: S.P.E.C.T.R.E.–The Special Executive for Counterintelligence, Terrorism, Revenge, and Extortion

facts.fact: SPECTRE由20名成员与主席组成，成员分属6个犯罪与颠覆组织各3人，另有两名科学家科策与马斯洛夫
facts.fact_en: SPECTRE consists of twenty members and a chairman; the members come in threes from six criminal and subversive organisations, plus two scientists, Kotze and Maslov.
facts.quote: There were three Sicilians from the top echelon of the Unione Siciliano

facts.fact: SPECTRE成员编号每月1日午夜按轮值前进两位数，布洛菲尔德本月编号为2号
facts.fact_en: SPECTRE members' numbers advance by two digits at midnight on the first of each month by rotation; this month Blofeld's number is 2.
facts.quote: the numbers from one to twenty-one that were their only names

facts.fact: 布洛菲尔德以电椅处决12号博罗，因其强奸了被绑架的布隆伯格之女，并退还50万美元赎金致歉
facts.fact_en: Blofeld has No. 12, Borraud, executed in the electric chair for raping the kidnapped daughter of Blomberg, and returns $500,000 of the ransom by way of apology.
facts.quote: The body of Pierre Borraud, seized in the iron fist of 3000 volts

facts.fact: SPECTRE此前3年总收入约150万英镑，每名成员分得约6万英镑
facts.fact_en: SPECTRE's total income over the previous three years was about £1.5 million, roughly £60,000 per member.
facts.quote: the total income to date, not counting our last and undistributed dividend

facts.fact: 利普为SPECTRE次级特工G，因与邦德冲突烧伤住院，布洛菲尔德下令其寄信后24小时内将其处决
facts.fact_en: Lippe is SPECTRE sub-agent G; after being burned in his clash with Bond and hospitalised, Blofeld orders him to be eliminated within 24 hours of posting the letter.
facts.quote: this is an unreliable agent. The German section will make arrangements for his elimination

facts.fact: 拉戈为SPECTRE的1号，布洛菲尔德指定继承人，欧米茄计划现场最高指挥
facts.fact_en: Largo is SPECTRE's No. 1, Blofeld's designated successor, and supreme commander in the field for Operation Omega.
facts.quote: No. 1 will be Supreme Commander in the field

facts.fact: 赎金金条拟在埃特纳火山西北坡海拔2000至3000米处空投，由5架马克IV型运输彗星机运送
facts.fact_en: The gold ransom is to be dropped by parachute on the north-west slopes of Mount Etna, between 2,000 and 3,000 metres, and carried by five Mark IV Transport Comet aircraft.
facts.quote: Area T, is on the northwest slopes of Mount Etna

facts.fact: 勒索信于1959年6月3日8时30分在布赖顿寄出，收信人为英国首相，索要价值1亿英镑的纯度1000金条
facts.fact_en: The blackmail letter was posted at Brighton at 8:30 a.m. on 3 June 1959, addressed to the British Prime Minister, demanding £100 million in gold bars of 1000 fineness.
facts.quote: postmarked Brighton, 8:30 a.m. on June 3

facts.fact: 勒索限期为1959年6月3日17时起7天，即6月10日17时，逾期先炸价值不低于1亿英镑的财产，48小时后再炸一座大城市
facts.fact_en: The deadline runs seven days from 5 p.m. on 3 June 1959, that is, 5 p.m. on 10 June; if it passes, SPECTRE will first destroy property worth at least £100 million, and 48 hours later a major city.
facts.quote: not later than 5 p.m. G.M.T. on June 10th, 1959

facts.fact: 失踪飞机为维利尔斯复仇者号O/NBR，隶属博斯科姆唐第5皇家空军试验中队，载两枚核弹，编号MOS/bd/654/Mk V与MOS/bd/655/Mk V
facts.fact_en: The missing aircraft is the Villiers Vindicator O/NBR of No. 5 R.A.F. Experimental Squadron, Boscombe Down, carrying two atomic bombs numbered MOS/bd/654/Mk V and MOS/bd/655/Mk V.
facts.quote: Villiers Vindicator O/NBR from No. 5 R.A.F. Experimental Squadron

facts.fact: 失踪飞机机组5人加意大利观察员朱塞佩·佩塔基，6人全部死亡
facts.fact_en: The missing aircraft carried a crew of five plus the Italian observer Giuseppe Petacchi; all six are dead.
facts.quote: The crew and the observer are deceased

facts.fact: M根据DEW雷达疑似信号推测飞机南飞巴哈马，派邦德前往拿骚调查
facts.fact_en: On the basis of a suspected DEW radar trace, M guesses the aircraft flew south to the Bahamas and sends Bond to Nassau to investigate.
facts.quote: I decided on the Bahamas, the group of islands

facts.fact: 利普在伦敦街头企图枪杀邦德，被SPECTRE的6号骑摩托车以手榴弹炸死
facts.fact_en: Lippe tries to shoot Bond in a London street and is blown up by SPECTRE's No. 6, who kills him with a grenade from a motorcycle.
facts.quote: the remains of his windshield, already shattered, cascaded around him

facts.fact: 佩塔基以氰化物毒气在4分钟内杀死5名机组人员，独自驾机飞往巴哈马
facts.fact_en: Petacchi kills the five-man crew with cyanide gas in four minutes and flies the bomber alone to the Bahamas.
facts.quote: Four minutes flat

facts.fact: SPECTRE以100万美元、新护照与去里约热内卢的机票收买佩塔基劫机，佩塔基未被告知与核弹有关
facts.fact_en: SPECTRE bought Petacchi with $1,000,000, a new passport and a ticket to Rio de Janeiro; Petacchi was not told that atomic bombs were involved.
facts.quote: Petacchi would receive $1,000,000, a new passport in any name

facts.fact: 佩塔基迫降后在机翼上被瓦尔加斯以短剑自下颌刺入脑部杀死
facts.fact_en: After ditching the bomber, Petacchi is killed on the wing by Vargas, who drives a stiletto up under his chin into his brain.
facts.quote: the stiletto flashed up and under the offered chin

facts.fact: 拉戈约40岁，罗马人，曾为那不勒斯黑市头目、丹吉尔走私者与法国里维埃拉珠宝大盗
facts.fact_en: Largo, about 40, is a Roman who was a Naples black-market boss, a Tangier smuggler and a Riviera jewel thief in France.
facts.quote: He was a Roman and he looked like a Roman

facts.fact: 飞碟号为水翼快艇，由墨西拿的莱奥波尔多·罗德里格斯公司建造，造价20万英镑，航速约50节
facts.fact_en: The Disco Volante is a hydrofoil yacht built by Leopoldo Rodriguez of Messina, costing £200,000, with a speed of about 50 knots.
facts.quote: could move her hundred tons at around fifty knots

facts.fact: 两枚核弹被藏于狗岛岩洞内，距拿骚约100英里
facts.fact_en: The two atomic bombs are hidden in a cave under Dog Island, about a hundred miles from Nassau.
facts.quote: a hundred miles from Nassau

facts.fact: 科策为核弹改装定时引信，引爆器装在飞行员座位下的铅盒中
facts.fact_en: Kotze fits the atomic bombs with time fuses; the detonators are kept in a lead box under the pilot's seat.
facts.quote: They were in a leaden box under the pilot's seat

facts.fact: 多米诺本名多米内塔·佩塔基，29岁，生于博尔扎诺，父母死于火车事故，曾就读切尔滕纳姆女子学院与皇家戏剧艺术学院
facts.fact_en: Domino's real name is Dominetta Petacchi; she is 29, born in Bolzano, her parents died in a train accident, and she was educated at Cheltenham Ladies' College and the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art.
facts.quote: My name's Dominetta Vitali. But I was sent to school in England

facts.fact: 多米诺右腿比左腿短1英寸，致轻微跛行
facts.fact_en: Domino's right leg is one inch shorter than her left, leaving her with a slight limp.
facts.quote: I have one leg an inch shorter than the other

facts.fact: 莱特右手为钢钩假肢，曾离开中情局加入平克顿侦探社，行动中被征召归队
facts.fact_en: Leiter's right hand is a steel-hook prosthesis; he left the CIA to join the Pinkerton detective agency and was recalled to duty for this operation.
facts.quote: thrust the steel hook that was his right hand under Bond's arm

facts.fact: 飞碟号载有约40人，包括19名股东与船员，拉戈称其为寻宝团
facts.fact_en: The Disco Volante carries about forty people, including nineteen shareholders and the crew; Largo calls them a treasure-hunting syndicate.
facts.quote: With the crew, there are forty of us

facts.fact: 飞碟号实际仅载500加仑柴油，与拉戈所称的大量燃油与压载舱说法不符
facts.fact_en: The Disco in fact carries a maximum of 500 gallons of diesel, contradicting Largo's claims about her large fuel and ballast tanks.
facts.quote: She carries a maximum of five hundred gallons of Diesel

facts.fact: 邦德在赌场与拉戈对赌chemin de fer三连胜，赢得1600美元
facts.fact_en: Bond plays chemin de fer against Largo at the casino and wins three coups in a row, winning $1,600.
facts.quote: I have made sixteen hundred dollars in two coups

facts.fact: 多米诺向邦德坦言本姓佩塔基，兄长朱塞佩为飞行员
facts.fact_en: Domino tells Bond that her family name is Petacchi and that her brother Giuseppe is a pilot.
facts.quote: Is your family name Petacchi, then?

facts.fact: 邦德夜潜飞碟号发现船底约12英尺见方水下舱门，盖革计数器读数正常
facts.fact_en: Diving on the Disco at night, Bond finds a roughly twelve-foot-square underwater hatch in her hull; the Geiger counter reads normal.
facts.quote: About twelve feet square, divided down the center

facts.fact: 邦德水下遭SPECTRE哨兵以二氧化碳鱼枪袭击，哨兵被大梭鱼咬死
facts.fact_en: Underwater, Bond is attacked by a SPECTRE sentry with a CO2 spear gun; the sentry is killed by a great barracuda.
facts.quote: shreds of black rubber hanging from its jaws, Bond saw the barracuda

facts.fact: 莱特认出化名埃米尔·特劳特的股东实为东德物理学家科策，其5年前投奔西方后隐居瑞士
facts.fact_en: Leiter recognises the shareholder calling himself Emil Traut as the East German physicist Kotze, who defected to the West five years earlier and retired to Switzerland.
facts.quote: That's the same guy. The file went through my hands

facts.fact: 邦德在失事飞机内找到佩塔基的身份牌，编号15932，及其金劳力士表
facts.fact_en: In the wrecked bomber Bond finds Petacchi's identity disc, No. 15932, and his gold Rolex watch.
facts.quote: Giuseppe Petacchi. No. 15932

facts.fact: 失事飞机上的两枚核弹与引信均已被取走，邦德仅取回氰化物罐
facts.fact_en: The two atomic bombs and their fuses have already been removed from the wrecked bomber; Bond takes only the cyanide canister.
facts.quote: He found the red-striped cyanide canister and tucked it into his belt

facts.fact: 多米诺得知兄长死讯后同意携带盖革计数器登船做内应，以是否上甲板为信号
facts.fact_en: On learning of her brother's death, Domino agrees to go aboard as Bond's agent carrying a Geiger counter, with her coming up on deck as the signal.
facts.quote: If the bombs are there, I will come up on deck

facts.fact: 曼塔号为乔治·华盛顿级核潜艇，舰长P·佩德森，载16枚北极星导弹，潜航速度约40节
facts.fact_en: The Manta is a George Washington-class nuclear submarine, commanded by Commander P. Pedersen, carrying sixteen Polaris missiles, with a submerged speed of about 40 knots.
facts.quote: She's one of the George Washington Class, about four thousand tons

facts.fact: 飞碟号水上飞机于17时30分返回，飞碟号17时55分全速向西北出航，多米诺登船后未再上甲板
facts.fact_en: The Disco's seaplane returned at 17:30, and the Disco sailed at full speed to the north-west at 17:55; Domino boarded and was never seen on deck again.
facts.quote: DISCO SAILED AT 1755, FULL SPEED, COURSE NORTHWEST

facts.fact: 多米诺携带的伪装盖革计数器被发现，读数超过500毫伦琴，拉戈以雪茄与冰块折磨逼供，她一言不发
facts.fact_en: Domino's disguised Geiger counter is discovered, reading over 500 milliroentgens; Largo tortures her with a cigar and ice to make her talk, and she says nothing.
facts.quote: The counter was, very naturally, registering over 500 milliroentgens

facts.fact: 俄罗斯人斯特雷利克在会上提议各组留人监督，被拉戈以0.25口径柯尔特手枪当场打死
facts.fact_en: The Russian Strelik proposes at the meeting that each group leave a man behind to supervise, and is shot dead on the spot by Largo with a .25 Colt pistol.
facts.quote: The three bullets pumped so quickly into the face of the Russian

facts.fact: 第一枚核弹目标为大巴哈马岛导弹基地，计划午夜3时锚泊，潜水队游半英里布放
facts.fact_en: The first atomic bomb is intended for the missile base on Grand Bahama, to be anchored at exactly 3 a.m., with the swimming party covering half a mile to lay it.
facts.quote: We shall anchor at exactly three a.m. and the swimming party will leave

facts.fact: 多米诺挣脱束缚潜出船舱，以鱼枪刺穿拉戈脖颈将其杀死，救下邦德
facts.fact_en: Domino breaks free of her bonds and swims out of the cabin, killing Largo with a spear through the neck and saving Bond.
facts.quote: Largo, Largo with a spear sticking horribly through his neck

facts.fact: 两枚核弹均已回收，科策被捕后供出SPECTRE内情，布洛菲尔德逃脱
facts.fact_en: Both atomic bombs are recovered; Kotze, captured, tells all he knows about SPECTRE, and Blofeld escapes.
facts.quote: They've recovered both bombs, and Kotze–the physicist chap–is singing like a bird

facts.fact: 第二枚核弹原定目标为迈阿密，计划布放在游艇港
facts.fact_en: The second atomic bomb was intended for Miami, to be laid in the yacht harbour.

story_timeline: 1959年5月，邦德因体检不佳被M强制送往灌木林疗养院两周，期间与利普结仇并遭谋杀未遂；疗养结束次日SPECTRE在巴黎开会，欧米茄计划因利普误事延期一周；1959年6月2日晚8时，佩塔基劫持复仇者号轰炸机并毒死5名机组人员，当夜在比米尼附近迫降后被灭口，两枚核弹被取走藏于狗岛；1959年6月3日8时30分勒索信在布赖顿寄出，限期6月10日17时；邦德与莱特6月4日前后抵达拿骚调查；6月9日17时55分飞碟号出航北上；6月10日凌晨3时前后水下决战，拉戈被杀，两枚核弹回收。注：信内日期为1959年，小说出版于1961年，原文如此。
synopsis_en: After a damning medical report, James Bond is ordered by M to spend two weeks at Shrublands, a nature-cure clinic in Sussex, where he crosses Count Lippe, a SPECTRE sub-agent who tries to kill him on a traction machine. Meanwhile, in Paris, Ernst Stavro Blofeld - making his first appearance in the series - chairs a meeting of SPECTRE, the Special Executive for Counterintelligence, Terrorism, Revenge, and Extortion, and approves Operation Omega: the theft of a British bomber carrying two atomic bombs, and a demand for £100 million in gold from the British government. The Italian observer Giuseppe Petacchi murders the crew with cyanide gas, ditches the aircraft off Bimini, and is himself murdered by Largo's men; the bombs are hidden in a cave under Dog Island. Acting on a hunch drawn from DEW radar traces, M sends Bond to Nassau in the Bahamas, where, with CIA man Felix Leiter, he investigates Emilio Largo's hydrofoil yacht Disco Volante and wins the trust of Largo's mistress Domino Vitali - Petacchi's sister. Domino smuggles a Geiger counter aboard the Disco, confirming that the bombs are there. In a night underwater battle off Grand Bahama, Largo's frogmen are defeated; Domino kills Largo with a spear gun, both bombs are recovered, and Blofeld escapes.
